notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.2.2: Business Finder now collects more cold-call context from Google Places, including business status, opening hours/open-now data and service-area signals. Browser CRM V1.4 adds a dedicated Call Intel view, live Refresh Call Intel for Google-linked leads, stronger business-specific openers and answer-likelihood guidance, plus Call Any Lead so any saved lead with a phone number can be called even when it is not in the Call Queue. Pipeline cards now also expose direct Call actions.
